title: Germ detection on the punctured power-series zero section
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian commutative local ring of depth at least two [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-depth]. Let $d>0$, set $B=A[[X_1,\ldots,X_d]]$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series], and let $z:\operatorname{Spec}A\to Y=\operatorname{Spec}B$ be induced by constant coefficient [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $V\subset Y$ be open with $z^{-1}(V)=\operatorname{Spec}A\setminus\{\mathfrak m_A\}$. Write $U=z^{-1}(V)$ and $z_V:U\to V$ for the restriction of $z$. For $x\in U$, write $g_x:\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)\to\mathcal O_{V,z_V(x)}$ for the germ map. If $s\in\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)$ satisfies $g_x(s)=0$ for every $x\in U$, then $s=0$.

proof.text: Apply associated-germ detection on the Noetherian power-series ring. For each associated prime q, apply associatedPrimes_quotient_map_of_flat with I=bot, using constants_flat and quotientBot linear equivalences. This gives p associated to A and q associated to B/pB. The prime-extension theorem makes pB prime, so the associated-prime radical equality identifies q=pB.

The depth bound applied to p excludes the maximal ideal, whose quotient is a field of Krull dimension zero. The inclusion pB into constantCoeff-comap p gives q specializing to z(p). The open inverse-image hypothesis puts z(p) in V. Restrict the specialization to V and apply germ_stalkSpecializes to the zero germ furnished by hs. Associated-germ detection concludes.

theorem eq_zero_of_powerSeries_punctured_germs
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (hdepth : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := A) A)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (V : (Spec (.of (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A))).Opens)
    (hV : ∀ x : Spec (.of A),
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d)))) x ∈ V ↔
        x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint A)
    (s : Γ(V.toScheme, ⊤))
    (hs : ∀ x :
      ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d) (R := A)))) ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme,
      (V.toScheme.presheaf.Γgerm
        ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d) (R := A))) ∣_ V) x)).hom s = 0) :
    s = 0
